d: Short, messy salmon-pink hair with choppy bangs and a single thin braid resting on the left shoulder. Large, expressive amethyst-purple eyes on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build, wearing a navy blue and white sailor-style top with a matching white mini-skirt, a dark utility belt with pouches, and white platform sandals. Accessories include a white sailor cap, a black choker, a cross-body black bag with a small white plushie charm, and a white futuristic handheld device with purple accents.
